# 1 Enoch Chapter 105 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**1** I and my son will be joined with them forever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and you shall have peace. Rejoice, children of uprightness. Amen.

**2** [Variant text, secondary: And now I say to you, sons of men: love knowledge and wisdom in every generation, and walk in the ways of all My creation; for God has set an end for all works, and what is given to your hearts shall be accomplished. And you shall rejoice and have abundance, and love God, and He will keep you; and your heart shall be strengthened and your mouth filled with praise, and you shall praise God. And a parable is given to you from the Holy and Great One.]

---

*LOGOS notes: Chapter 105 may be only one verse in its original form. V. 1's "I and my son" is textually ambiguous — the referent of "my son" is unclear (Methuselah? a messianic figure?). The closing "Amen" is liturgically significant and unusual in this context. V. 2 appears in some Ethiopic manuscripts as an expansion, possibly a later addition to provide a more complete conclusion to the Epistle before the Noah appendix (chs. 106–107).*
